analysis_status: descriptive protocol frozen after an exploratory coverage audit; not result-blind preregistration
claim_boundary: The census estimates prevalence only in AgentDojo v1.1.2 official benign ground-truth trajectories. It is not an ecosystem-wide estimate, an attack evaluation, or proof that the normalization is complete for unseen tools and states.

definitions.compound_call: more than one normalized logical effect unit
definitions.cross_namespace_call: effect units modify more than one logical subsystem
definitions.effectful_call: one or more normalized logical effect units
definitions.multi_target_call: more than one non-null target principal

execution.environment: fresh in-memory suite state per user task

oracle.logical_unit_rule: Collapse storage mirrors and metadata into one resource mutation; expand independently addressable principals, messages, permissions, membership changes, and per-object read-state changes.

population.call_selection: all calls in each official ground-truth trajectory
